pages.title: Panakeia Extractor
pages.text: A machine that consumes Panakeia, water and FE to produce Liquid Panakeia.$(br2)Place Panakeia in the input slot and supply water and FE to begin extraction. Panakeia Cubes are also accepted. The fluid yield depends on the input.

pages.title: Liquid Panakeia
pages.text: The extracted fluid is used in the $(l:machine/alchemical_reactor)Alchemical Reactor$(/l).$(br2)Supply water using fluid containers or external fluid transport. Collect Liquid Panakeia through the output container slot or external fluid transport.

pages.title: Upgrades and Capacity
pages.text: Supports Energy Capacity and Tank Capacity Upgrades.$(br2)Both tanks must be large enough for the water and fluid output of a single operation. Increase tank capacity before using inputs with a large fluid yield.
